naming: The loader reads the document with YamlDotNet's CamelCaseNamingConvention and refuses any key it does not know.

keys.description: Always repository: the file osdu-delivery.yaml (or osdu-delivery.yml) at the root of a repository, naming the code every run of its flows carries in the correlation id of its OSDU requests, and optionally the team its flows belong to. A flow takes the nearest one in its folder or a folder above it, up to the folder holding .git.

The repository's code: the segment after osdu-delivery in the correlation id of every OSDU request its flows' runs send, `osdu-delivery-<code>-<operation>-<run id>`. A lower-case letter, then lower-case letters and digits, at most 16 in all and no hyphen.

The team the flows under the document belong to, of every kind: the work the nodes do for them is charged to it, and the Compute usage page sums by it. One line of at most 64 characters. A folder's own document names the team of the flows under it; a document with no team leaves them with the team of the document above. Recorded by each sync of the repository, and applied to the work that ends after it.
